description_sq:
Shitet apartament ne zonen e Freskut prane Shkolles 17 Shkurti . 
Organizimi i saj si me poshte ; 
- 1 korridor shperndares 
- 1 Ambjent Ndenje me nje kend gatimi 
- 2 dhoma Gjumi 
- 2 Tualete 
- 1 kend ( Depo ) 
- 2 Ballkone me hyrje- dalje nga dhoma e ndenjes dhe 1 prej dhomave te gjumit 
- kati i 2 
- siperfaqe neto 102.5 dhe siperfaqe bruto 118.5 
Apartamenti eshte investuar se fundmi , me instalimet Elektrike , Hidraulike , lyerje . dhe i mobiluar pjeserisht ( guzhina , 2 dhomat e gjumit ) dhe ofron nje planimetri te rregullt 
Zona ofron komoditet jetese dhe ofron ajer te paster .
description_en: Apartment for sale in the Fresk area near the February 17 School. Its organization is as follows; - 1 distribution corridor - 1 living room with a kitchen corner - 2 bedrooms - 2 toilets - 1 corner (storage room) - 2 balconies with entrance-exit from the living room and 1 of the bedrooms - 2nd floor - net area 102.5 and gross area 118.5 The apartment was recently invested, with electrical, plumbing, painting installations . and partially furnished (kitchen, 2 bedrooms) and offers a regular layout. The area offers comfortable living and offers clean air.
